deployment_requirements: Record a playable, reviewed candidate and its relevant native/browser readiness evidence before deployment. Current camera code-only qualification is not normal browser readiness.

Use dedicated ClubScape application/database services, private persistence and least-privilege runtime configuration. Do not reuse the development database or either consumed saved-state continuation.

Stage only identified application code and approved public runtime assets. Exclude .local, .worktrees, Git/session data, private checkpoints, credentials and the unrelated feedback archive from Docker build contexts and images.
Bind only an available 127.0.0.1 application port; do not publish PostgreSQL. Select exact ports after inspecting the host at deployment time.
Provide Docker Lander metadata for the application and hide its infrastructure service. The owner-facing URL must be the Mac localhost SSH-forward endpoint, not a plain-HTTP LAN URL.
Build and start only the ClubScape services. Do not run unscoped compose up/down, down --volumes, volume pruning or unrelated service recreation.
Preserve owner data on subsequent updates and failures. Report real readiness failures; an account-only or fenced page is not a successful playable deployment.

Publish the exact image/revision, container identities, localhost URL and SSH command only after real deployment checks. Do not claim Mac rendering/audio/performance checks that only the owner can perform.
